title: Present Perfect — have / has + past participle
titleIt: Present Perfect — have / has + participio passato
examples: She has worked here for three years.
explanation: Use the Present Perfect for actions connected to now: recent results, life experience, or unfinished time periods.
explanationIt: Usa il Present Perfect per azioni collegate al presente: risultati recenti, esperienze o periodi non conclusi.

exercises.prompt: She ____ worked here for five years.
Fix: I have finish my homework.
